name: Fumi Zweihänder
source:
A severe and intelligent woman whose scorn could wither the ignorant at 20 yards. To her friends and lovers though she is a confidence personified who, along with her sharp beauty, tends to attract everyone in the room.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sadpandastudios/hush-hush-only-your-love-can-save-them/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
